[Deesh Crozli speaks an alien language]|quoteend=0|Mae-ho Aniseya and Deesh Crozli|audio=Mae-Deesh-LostFound.flac|{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}}} '''Deesh Crozli''' was a [[Color|black]]-skinned [[Deesh Crozli's species|alien]] who left her [[Deesh Crozli's homeworld|homeworld]] and ended up on the [[planet]] [[Ueda]], where she kept her ear to the ground for information to [[Information broker|trade]]. As Crozli's soft tissue needed to be immersed in an [[Atmosphere|atmospheric]] mixture that matched that of her [[homeworld]] periodically, she wore a black [[pressure-mask]] with red lenses while on Ueda, hiding her face. She also wore black [[Clothing|robes]], a brown [[Currency|money]] [[belt]] that she kept well-secured, and a gray [[gas mixture monitor]] on her chest. In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} Crozli was sitting by the gate into [[Point Ueda]], the [[capital]] of Ueda, when the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] [[Mae's quest|approached]] her and produced two [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]].{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} {{AD|Disney+}} Aniseya asked where the local [[Jedi]], [[Jedi Master|Master]] [[Indara]], was located and Crozli pointed into the city and spoke in an [[alien]] [[language]]. In response, Aniseya placed the [[coin]]s in a basket on Crozli's lap. The [[assassin]] then proceeded to the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]], where she [[Indara's murder|murdered]] Indara. ==Behind the scenes== Deesh Crozli first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]]," the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} Concept art of the character was titled "A Spy" was created by [[Ivan Manzella]],''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' who also produced a render of Crozli's full head.{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creatures & Character Designs|author=Manzella, Ivan|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20190121223617}} The character is also visible in concept art of the Ueda Village Gate created by [[Kevin Jenkins]] and [[Stephen Tappin]]. The Ueda gate scene was shot at [[Shinfield Studios]],{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}} [[Wikipedia:England|England]].{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}} Prior to the release of the episode, Crozli was revealed in a trailer exclusively shown at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]]{{CelebrationTrailer|''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''|Celebration Europe (2023)}} during the [[Lucasfilm]] Studio Showcase on [[April 7]], [[2023]].{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-lucasfilm-studio-showcase|text=SWCE 2023: 11 Highlights from Lucasfilm's Studio Showcase}} She was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. ===Concept art galleries=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:Unidentified-Masked-Alien-Manzella.jpg|"A Spy" by [[Ivan Manzella]] File:StreetViewOfUedaVillageGate-JenkinsTappin-ArtOfTheAcolyte.png|Street View of Ueda Village Gate, [[Kevin Jenkins]] and [[Stephen Tappin]] |digital= File:Masked-Alien-Head-Sculpt-Manzella.jpg|Render by Ivan Manzella |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Deesh Crozli}} *{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{CelebrationTrailer|''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''|Celebration Europe (2023)}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|BtytYWhg2mc|The Acolyte | Official Trailer | Disney+}} *{{SWYouTube|zotV8szyesw|The Acolyte | Creating the Acolyte | Streaming June 4 on Disney+}} {{Video}} *{{SWYouTube|9DItelHk3ng|The Acolyte Launch Event Recap}} {{Video}} *{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-creature-shop-bazil-reveal|text=Inside ''The Acolyte'' Creature Shop: Meet Bazil, the Tynnan Tracker -
